title: Artifact
description: Liuye 5-protocol member · Artifact + ArtifactPatch (v3 spec §2.2). ordered JSON Patch with monotonic version · NOT default-CRDT · supports chunked patches (P1-10 R10).

id.description: Stable artifact identifier · stable across versions.

schema_version.description: Liuye contract schema version · fixed '1' for the current spec lock.

type.description: 5-enum lock (v3 §2.2 + brief §4.2 hardline). Adding a sixth value requires PM ratify + RFC.

status.description: Lifecycle status. streaming = patches still arriving · partial = some chunks missing · resolved = final snapshot ready · failed = aborted.

source_tool_call_id.description: The ToolCall.id that produced this Artifact (root cause · Cowork→Managed handoff still references the original cowork tool_call_id via parent_tool_call_id chain).

owner_agent.description: Which Cowork agent owns this artifact's snapshot schema (Managed agents alert/compliance/riskctrl do not emit Artifacts directly · they write to decision_ledger instead per §3.1.1).

title.description: Human-readable title shown in artifact panel header.

version.description: Monotonic integer · increments by 1 per applied patch. version=0 = initial empty artifact.

patches.description: Ordered JSON Patch history · most recent at end. Replay-able to reconstruct snapshot from base.

snapshot.description: Current materialized snapshot · validated against per-type outputSchema (e.g. CreditDecisionV1 / ReportDraftV1 / ChannelSearchV1). Schema is open here · type-specific narrowing happens at consumer side via inputSchemas.ts.

verdict.description: Optional QC verdict (e.g. quality_scorer 9-dim gate result). PARTIAL = some dimensions failed but artifact still usable.

total.description: Total QC dimensions evaluated (typically 9 per §8 quality_scorer).

qc_score.description: QC pass/total counter · presented alongside verdict.

evidence_refs.description: EvidenceRef.id list · all evidence backing this artifact's snapshot. evidence_refs MAY be empty during streaming but MUST be populated by resolved.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC · matches Python datetime.isoformat() and JS toISOString().

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC · updated on every patch application.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC · set when status transitions to resolved or failed.

id.description: Patch identifier · unique within an artifact's patches[].

artifact_id.description: Parent Artifact.id this patch belongs to.

base_version.description: Artifact.version this patch is applied against · client rejects patch if Artifact.version != base_version (version mismatch → full snapshot pull · v3 §2.2 hardline).

next_version.description: Artifact.version after this patch applies · must equal base_version + 1.

op.description: Patch operation type. replace = overwrite at path · append = push to array at path · merge = deep-merge object at path.

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into Artifact.snapshot · e.g. '/sections/0/body' or '/candidates'.

value.description: Value to apply at path · type depends on op (replace=any · append=item · merge=object). Open schema · per-type narrowing at consumer side.

chunk_index.description: P1-10 R10 chunked patch · chunk index starts at 0 and increments monotonically. Missing chunk_index/chunk_total = non-chunked patch (legacy compat).

chunk_total.description: P1-10 R10 chunked patch · total chunk count. Missing chunk_total = non-chunked patch. Client triggers full snapshot pull on chunk gap / version mismatch / chunk_total inconsistency.

chunk_assembly.description: P1-10 R10 chunked patch · streaming = partial render allowed · final = merge into complete snapshot. Single chunk size ≤ 64KB per v3 §2.2 hardline.
